data-in-decisions-flow.alt: Three rows, each from data to who decides to the decision. A census count of children by district goes to a local school board, which decides where to build a new school. Satellite images of a flood go to a national government agency, which decides where to send boats and food. A census count of people by state feeds a formula in United States federal law, at the national scale, that sets the seats each state gets in the House.
